question: The salaries and allowances of the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly and Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the State Legislative Council are fixed by the _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is **State** **Legislature**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The salaries and allowances of the **Speaker and Deputy Speaker **of the Legislative Assembly and **Chairman and Deputy Chairman** of the State Legislative Council are typically fixed by the **State legislature**.

**Speaker** **and** **Deputy** **Speaker**:

 
• Election: The Speaker and Deputy Speaker are elected by the members of the Legislative Assembly.
 
• Tenure: They hold office during the term of the Legislative Assembly unless they resign or are disqualified.
 
• **Powers and Functions:**
 
 
• The Speaker presides over the sessions of the Legislative Assembly.
 
• They maintain order and decorum, decide on points of order, and have the casting vote in case of a tie.
 
• The Deputy Speaker assists the Speaker and performs the Speaker's duties in their absence.
 
 

**Chairman** **and** **Deputy** **Chairman** of the **State** **Legislative** **Council**:

 
• Election: The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the State Legislative Council are elected by the members of the Legislative Council.
 
• Tenure: They hold office during the term of the Legislative Council unless they resign or are disqualified.
 
• **Powers and Functions**:
 
 
• The Chairman presides over the sessions of the Legislative Council.
 
• They maintain order and decorum and have the casting vote in case of a tie.
 
• The Deputy Chairman assists the Chairman and performs the Chairman's duties in their absence.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**State** **Legislature**:

 
• The State Legislature is the legislative branch of the state government in India.
 
• It consists of two houses: the Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) and the Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) in states where it is bicameral.
 
• Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) are elected by the public through general elections. 
 
• Members of the Legislative Council (MLCs) are often elected by various constituencies, graduates, teachers, etc.
 
• The State Legislature is responsible for making laws, approving the budget, and overseeing the executive branch.
